other_names: Vänthallen (Hallandstrafiken's name for the waiting hall)
levels.note: The new station opened with the Varbergstunneln on 14 July 2025 (inauguration 13 July). The station building (Jernhusen, Stationstorget 1) stands at street level about 150 m north of the old 1880 building, over the trough by the tunnel's northern mouth.

levels.name: Plattformsnivå (platforms sunk in an open trough, one floor below the station building)
levels.note: Trafikverket: platforms lowered in an open trough (tråg) below ground level; five tracks, four of them at platforms, one through track. The planning drawings show one island platform (mittplattform) and one side platform (sidoplattform). OSM tags platforms 1B, 2 (2A/2B), 4 (4A/4B) and 5 (5A/5B) on level -1. It is not a deep tunnel station: the platforms are in the open trough, the tunnel starts south of the station.

answers.question: (no open questions listed for Varberg in STATION_OPEN_QUESTIONS_SWEDEN.md; brief asks to describe the new station's levels, lifts and entrances)
answers.answer: Two levels: street/terminal level with the station building (vänthallen, kundservice) and the footbridge, and the platform level in an open trough one floor below. Access at the south end from the station building (lifts, escalators, stairs) and at the north end from Alida Svenssons gång- och cykelbro (lifts, stairs). Trafikverket confirms lifts, stairs, escalators and the footbridge; their exact positions come from OSM (4 lifts, 4 escalators).
answers._source: https://www.trafikverket.se/vara-projekt/projekt-i-hallands-lan/varbergstunneln, read 2026-10-30; Trafikverket, järnvägsplan Västkustbanan Varberg–Hamra, exhibition sheets "varberg_station.pdf" and "3_utstallningsplansch_stationsomradet_2" (https://bransch.trafikverket.se/contentassets/41247010aa8d422f933d034634736c1f/arkiv/varberg_station.pdf; .../arkiv-ovriga/3_utstallningsplansch_stationsomradet_2_131mb.pdf), planning-stage drawings, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract), read 2026-10-30

open: Exact number and position of lifts/escalators: Trafikverket's opened-station page confirms lifts, stairs and escalators but not where or how many; the planning drawing shows 3 lifts and 2 escalators, OSM has 4 of each. No as-built plan published.

Platform numbering: OSM uses 1B, 2 (2A/2B), 4 (4A/4B), 5 (5A/5B); Hallandstrafiken's map shows numbers 1, 2, 4, 5 without explanation. Which is the side platform vs the island (OSM suggests side = 1B/2, island = 4/5) is not stated by an owner source.

OSM still has old-station features ~200 m south (Pressbyrån n5240151252, Hallandstrafiken Kundservice n12156323070, toilets n5240151251, luggage locker n12156323072, entrances on Eskilsgatan n5240151253/4, platforms w71499118, w307498378, w307498379, w541968303 with no level). Hallandstrafiken now gives the kundservice at Stationstorget 1, and Wikipedia says the 1880 building is no longer part of the railway: these OSM objects look stale.
Pressbyrån hours: not on Jernhusen; pressbyran.se store page unreadable.

Shops in the station building: OSM shows Barber Station, Studio Terra and three vacant units; Jernhusen lists only Pressbyrån. Omami's site gives a Varberg restaurant at Västra Vallgatan 4 but does not say it is in the station.
Floor heights / trough depth: no source measures them.
